name: herdr-interactive-tool-block
description: Reports the Herdr pane as blocked while a rule says the agent is waiting on the user mid-execution. Modular rules cover interactive MCP tools (browser-tools click/input_text/pick), difit reviews, and Plannotator reviews.

enabled.description: Flip the Herdr pane to blocked while a rule reports the agent is waiting on the user

rules.description: Per-rule enablement. Set a rule id to false to disable it.

tools.description: Tool-name substrings for the interactive-tools rule; a matching tool is treated as blocking mid-execution
